report:
Skin, right shin, incisional biopsy

Received in formalin is an incisional biopsy of skin measuring 1.2 x 0.5 x 0.6 cm. Serially sliced and all embedded in 2 blocks.

(1-2) Incisional biopsy, serially sliced, all embedded.

Sections show a piece of skin down to the subcutis. The subcutis shows a septal panniculitis composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes and neutrophils, with septal thickening and fibrosis, Miescher radial granulomas and multinucleated giant cells. The overall features are those of a septal panniculitis, in keeping with erythema nodosum. Please correlate with clinical findings.

SKIN, right shin, incisional biopsy - SEPTAL PANNICULITIS, in keeping with ERYTHEMA NODOSUM
